api_analysis.hypothesis: model_new.py uses torch.detach which is flagged as prohibited torch computation. We can remove it because the reflection_pad2d_forward CUDA op returns a new tensor that is already detached from any computation graph; detach has no semantic effect in this context. The reference torch.detach after reflection_pad only ensures detachment, but our custom op produces a fresh tensor with no grad_fn, so the output is already detached. Therefore we can eliminate the torch.detach calls from forward and debug_forward, while keeping the same checkpoint IDs and values.
